card.text: Proxima Centauri b was found in 2016 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Proxima Centauri b"
sources.quote: Proxima Centauri b, also referred to as Proxima b, or Alpha Centauri Cb, is an exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star Proxima Centauri in the constellation Centaurus.

introduction.text: Orbital orientation unknown: the 47° plane is assumed. The map is a ROCKE-3D climate scenario; no atmosphere or ocean has been detected.
